decision_notes: The Silesian regional-government bulletin publishes dated ordinary Sejmik session recordings. Sessions VII/30/2026 (21 September) and VII/31/2026 (19 October) were visually reviewed beyond the opening at 1200 seconds in WebKit, with advancing decoded 1920x1080 video, speakers at the chamber lectern and officials on the dais. Normal visible cookie acknowledgement and player controls were used. The official page uses native HLS: Chromium did not decode either selected recording in these checks, while WebKit played both after a normal resume following seek. Use the official viewing page; browser compatibility is source-dependent. Current live, every committee and all audio/language tracks remain unverified.

Official bulletin archive link only. Published default reuse conditions call for source/time attribution and disclosure of processing, preserve the public-affairs purpose of disclosed personal data and reserve source-specific conditions for protected works. No prior-linking consent requirement was identified in the reviewed page; this does not establish an independent audiovisual licence. Retain personal-use permission pending. No embedded player or HLS/IPTV export is added; observed manifests are dated video on demand, not stable live services.
